data: Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3

Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030.
